_note: barkhorn's own bought parts, on top of the kit's library (studio/fabkit/library/components.json). From the horn-speaker research of 2026-10-10 (search-result snippets of makers' datasheets and retailer listings; pages could not be opened from this environment): confirm every figure on the datasheet before cutting a baffle. Geometry the datasheets leave out (flange thickness, magnet, roll, cap) is proportioned and marked so.

artofsound-jmlc-400.note: cut-off, coverage and throat flange not stated: confirm it takes the 4550's 2 x M6 on 76.2

felt-glides.model: Felt glides 30 mm, screw-in, a set of 4
